literal.prompt: В аккумуляторном электромобиле DC/DC-преобразователь даёт низковольтное питание аксессуарам и вспомогательной батарее. Какой компонент находится на его входе в силовой цепи?

literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L64 directly states that DC/DC takes higher-voltage DC from the traction battery pack and lowers it for accessories and auxiliary-battery recharge; L60/L62/L66 ground the other real components.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L64 directly states that DC/DC takes higher-voltage DC from the traction battery pack and lowers it for accessories and auxiliary-battery recharge; L60/L62/L66 ground the other real components.

literalGroups.literal: У DC/DC-преобразователя вход подключён к тяговому батарейному блоку: он отдаёт ток большего напряжения, который преобразователь снижает для аксессуаров и вспомогательной батареи. Тот же блок также питает электромотор, а бортовое зарядное устройство отдельно преобразует входящий переменный ток для зарядки.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L64 and L55/L66: traction pack supplies DC/DC and also powers motor; onboard charger handles incoming AC-to-DC charging.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L64 and L55/L66: traction pack supplies DC/DC and also powers motor; onboard charger handles incoming AC-to-DC charging.

literalGroups.literal: Автомобиль подключают через порт к розетке или зарядному оборудованию; при зарядке бортовое устройство отслеживает напряжение, ток, температуру и уровень заряда.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L55/L66: car plugs in to charge traction pack; onboard charger monitors voltage, current, temperature and state of charge.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L55/L66: car plugs in to charge traction pack; onboard charger monitors voltage, current, temperature and state of charge.

literalGroups.literal: Вспомогательная батарея электромобиля подаёт электричество на его аксессуары.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L60: auxiliary battery provides electricity for vehicle accessories.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L60: auxiliary battery provides electricity for vehicle accessories.

literalGroups.literal: Порт зарядки соединяет автомобиль с внешним источником питания, чтобы заряжать тяговый батарейный блок.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L62: charge port connects vehicle to external supply to charge traction pack.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L62: charge port connects vehicle to external supply to charge traction pack.

literalGroups.literal: Бортовое зарядное устройство преобразует входящий переменный ток в постоянный для зарядки тяговой батареи.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L66: onboard charger converts incoming AC to DC for traction-battery charging.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L66: onboard charger converts incoming AC to DC for traction-battery charging.

correctNoteNewFact.fact: While charging, the onboard charger monitors battery voltage, current, temperature and state of charge.
correctNoteNewFact.ground: This verified charging-context fact appears in the correct battery answer note and is additional to the question’s DC/DC input relation; it concerns the correct battery pack.

absoluteDifficulty.audienceKnowledgeGround: The question requires tracing the BEV low-voltage accessory path: the DC/DC converter receives power from the main pack and feeds accessories/auxiliary battery. It is not a generic battery-storage question: the prompt names the auxiliary battery as well, so “battery” alone cannot resolve which one is on the converter input; the learner must distinguish the two batteries and separate the external charging port/onboard charger from the internal DC path. A person familiar with EV architecture can reason it through; an adult outside the topic lacks the needed component-flow knowledge.
